name: streamlink-scoped-resource-budgets-for-656e
instr:
Streamlink cannot bound resource use in plugin parsing, traversal, imports, caching, and URL transformations. Callers need one composable policy that preserves existing behavior when no limits are configured.

`UtilityBudget`, `utility_budget_scope`, and `current_utility_budget` from `streamlink.utils.budget` must atomically account named dimensions; `consume` applies charges and `snapshot` returns immutable usage. Propagate child charges exactly once without relaxing parent limits, and expose immutable `UtilityUsage` snapshots from `streamlink.utils.usage`. For JSON, `output_nodes` counts mapping and list containers recursively, excluding scalar values. `UtilityLimitError` is a StreamlinkError from `streamlink.exceptions`; exhaustion must set deterministic `dimension`, `limit`, `attempted`, and `usage` attributes without committing rejected work or leaving partial mutable state.

Every bounded utility, including `LRUCache`, `search_dict`, `load_module`, `exec_module`, `parse_json`, `parse_html`, `parse_xml`, `parse_qsd`, `absolute_url`, and `update_qsd`, must lazily charge actual work where applicable. `search_dict` traversal is lazy and cycle-safe, and its optional visited-container and nesting-depth limits constrain only work actually reached without changing unlimited traversal results.
